tools.name: read_taxonomy
tools.description:
Get how items in a 1stDibs category are organized. The top-level categories
        are furniture, art, jewelry, and fashion. Returns the next-level categories and the
        facets for the category, each with its filter values and item counts. Use it to find
        valid filters for search_items

tools.name: browse_items
tools.description:

        items per page with price, availability, photos, and product page links; descriptions

tools.name: search_items
tools.description:
Search 1stDibs items by keyword, optionally narrowed by filters. Use it when

        with price, availability, photos, and product page links; descriptions are shortened.

tools.name: item_details
tools.description:
Get the full details of one 1stDibs item: description, price, availability,
        photos, product page and checkout links, specifications, and up to 6 you may also like items.
        Use it when the user asks about a specific item. Takes an item ID from search_items or
        browse_items.

tools.name: show_items
tools.description:
Show up to 8 1stDibs items to the user as visual cards with a photo,
        price, and a link to each product page. Use item IDs returned by search_items or
        browse_items, best match first.
